workshops.title: Apophenia Workshop
workshops.description: In this session, we will delve into the intriguing phenomena of pareidolia and apophenia—what they are, why they occur, and their connection to psychological conditions.

webinars.title: Webinar with Dr. Chudler
webinars.description: Known for his Emmy-winning projects BrainWorks and Neuroscience for Kids, Dr. Chudler will share insights to inspire high school students passionate about neuroscience.

webinars.title: Webinar with Dr. Moritz
webinars.description: Join us for a special webinar with Dr. Mortiz, who will share insights into his current neurotechnology research and career trajectories in neuroscience. He will also be answering questions through a live Q&A sesion!

fundraisers.title: Krispy Kreme Fundraiser
fundraisers.description: We are running a Digital Dozens fundraiser with Krispy Kreme to help support IYNA!

fundraisers.title: Support IYNA GoFundMe
fundraisers.description: Support local neuroscience education by donating to our GoFundMe. 100 percent of proceeds go towards IYNA LWSD Chapter and to hosting events and programs for our community.

labs.title: Brain Disection
labs.description: This hands-on experience offers an amazing opportunity to dive deep into the anatomy and function of the brain and its vital role in human health.

competitions.title: IYNA Brain Quiz
competitions.description: The Regional Brain Quiz is your chance to test your knowledge, compete with fellow students, and take the first stpe toward the National Brain Bee.

misc.title: Card Making Event
misc.description: The IYNA EHS Chapter is partnering with the EHS Junior Orthopedic Guild Club to host a card-making event where we will be creating heartfelt cards for hospital patients!
